name: Pinball Arcade: Harley-Davidson / 3rd Edition
storyline: Harley-Davidson - Third Edition (1999): Designed by industry veterans, Lonnie D. Ropp and John Borg, this table grabs your attention with its chrome trim, classic rock n roll soundtrack and loud shaker motor that simulates the roar of a real Harley motor. The playfield features a player controlled up-post between the flippers and a 1:10 scale model of a Harley-Davidson Fat Boy that does a wheelie to reveal a ball lock below it. This table was among the first to use three multi-ball modes: Speedometer Multi-ball, Stop Light Multi-ball and Harley Multi-ball.
